title: Finite-free beta construction and augmentation normalization
statement: Existence substep: under the hypotheses of the normalized finite-free beta theorem, there exists a natural beta comparison at every scheme satisfying AugmentationNormalized.

proof.text: Use finiteFreeScalarDerivedComparison_augmentation to identify the fixed two-term model with its augmented degree-zero target in the derived category. The remaining construction is schemewise and does not use the geometric comparison data.

Use the existing internal-module coequalizer comparison extendTensorNatIso, with inverse underlying extendForgetTensorObjIso.inv, for the ordinary coefficient tensor identification. Identify the pulled-back target with the single complex on the restricted regular module. Tensor this identification with a complex, apply mapBifunctorSingle₁Iso and the degreewise ordinary comparison. Naturality follows from tensor interchange and the single-complex comparison. Its (0,n) summand is exactly targetZeroIso tensor identity followed by the specified ordinary comparison.

Compare Q followed by derived tensor with the model, and Q followed by derived scalar change then exact restriction, to the same ordinary extension-restriction complex. The first comparison is Q lax multiplication, tensor augmentation, and the total comparison just constructed; the second is restricted scalarCounit and the restriction localization factor. On K-flat input the second is invertible by the total-left-derived counit theorem; the first is invertible by naturality of Q lax multiplication, the quasi-isomorphic augmentation, and the K-flat tensor-counit theorem. Fully faithful precomposition with localization of the full subcategory of native K-flat complexes descends their ratio to a natural isomorphism. The map-preimage identity gives exactly the required augmentation equation on every K-flat complex. Schemewise choice yields the stated family.

theorem finiteFreeScalarDerivedComparison_beta_construction
    (D : ScalarSixPullbackData.{u}) {Λ Λ' : ScalarSixRing.{u}}
    (a : Λ ⟶ Λ') (S : ShortComplex (PointModules Λ))
    (t : S.X₃ ≅ (Mod.comap a.hom.hom).obj (Mod.regular Λ'.X))
    (hS : S.ShortExact) (r : ℕ)
    (e₁ : S.X₁ ≅ biproduct (fun _ : Fin r ↦ Mod.regular Λ.X))
    (e₂ : S.X₂ ≅ biproduct (fun _ : Fin r ↦ Mod.regular Λ.X)) :
    ∃ β : ∀ Z : Scheme.{u}, tensorLeft (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (complex Λ S Z)) ≅
        scalarSixChange a Z ⋙ restriction a Z,
      ∀ Z, AugmentationNormalized a S t Z (β Z)
